transcript.text: Which region is the leading region? Answer with the region name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
Based on the working definition (region with most orders, joining orders to customers by customer_id), West leads with 339 orders, followed by South (316), East (286), and North (259).

FINAL ANSWER: West
